answers.core: Godot touts that is is collaboration friendly but this seems to be a major hurdle for working with others simultaneously.
answers.workaround: I'm not familiar enough with Godot to know if it is possible to circumvent the Id assignments but I feel this would be something like manually loading each resource using a script instead of building scenes using the editor.

title: Use GUID for Scene Resource Ids to prevent collisions when collaborating on the same scene file
